brief.headline: Nifty drops 1.75% as global tech rally fades; RBI allows SBI MF stake in South Indian Bank
brief.summary: Indian benchmark equity indices fell sharply ahead of the market holiday, with the Nifty 50 declining 1.75% to 25349.65 and Bank Nifty losing 3.17%. Global tech sentiment soured as Nvidia dropped 4.7% and Anthropic crashed below its $83 IPO price amid renewed US tariff concerns. Meanwhile, Jefferies reported India's economic activity growth reached a four-year high of 9% in October.

takeaways.text: SBI Mutual Fund received RBI approval to acquire up to 9.99% stake in South Indian Bank, communicated on November 23.
Adani Group plans to invest over $120 billion in capex over the next 5-6 years while maintaining net debt below 3.5 times EBITDA.
India's economic activity growth reached a four-year high of 9% year-on-year in October, driven by strong industrial activity, according to Jefferies.
JM Financial raised its 12-month target price on Poonawalla Fincorp to ₹625 from ₹550 with a Buy rating.
Anthropic shares crashed below their $83 IPO price to $79.42, erasing early post-listing gains as AI valuation concerns resurfaced.
Sanofi announced a $41 billion acquisition of Insmed at $175 per share, offering a 17.5% premium.

sections.india: Indian equity markets saw steep declines before the Guru Nanak Jayanti holiday, with Nifty 50 sliding 1.75% to 25349.65 and Bank Nifty dropping 3.17%. RBI approved SBI Mutual Fund to acquire up to 9.99% in South Indian Bank. Jefferies noted India's economic activity growth hit a four-year high of 9% in October. Meanwhile, Adani Group outlines $120 billion in capex over the next 5-6 years.
sections.world: US markets retreated as the Nasdaq fell 1.48% and Nvidia dropped 4.7%, reversing gains from Jensen Huang's return. White House plans for new tariffs on China and EU goods further weighed on equities and sent gold down 2% to 3539.8. Dell raised its revenue outlook as server demand doubled, while South Korea's Kospi surged 6.3%.
sections.tech: Anthropic shares plunged to $79.42, falling below their $83 IPO price after an initial debut rally faded. Jensen Huang addressed Nvidia staff in an all-hands meeting following his return, denying that President Trump personally got him rehired. Deeptech startup AidenAI raised $32 Mn, while CortexSpark Ventures launched a ₹1,000 Cr fund.

stories.title: Wall Street soars on Huang's return to Nvidia, Treasury yields rise
stories.summary: US stocks rebounded sharply on Monday after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive following pressure from President Donald Trump, reversing part of last week’s tech-led market rout. Nvidia jumped 31%, helping the Nasdaq 100 rise 6.5% and the S&P 500 4.7%, while Treasury yields and the dollar also climbed as investors reassessed both AI-sector sentiment and the Federal Reserve outlook.
stories.ai_summary: US stocks surged on Monday as Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following pressure from President Trump.
stories.why_it_matters: Positive for global tech sentiment, though initial relief faded in subsequent trading sessions.

South Indian Bank stated that the approval follows the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 and other applicable guidelines. The lender also reported a 21 percent year-on-year increase in net profit for the second quarter.

However, rural demand indicators remained weak due to a subdued monsoon. While bank credit growth reached a nearly 12-year high, inflationary pressures intensified simultaneously. Overall, the report highlights a mixed outlook for future…

stories.summary: SBI economists have lowered their rate hike expectations for the upcoming RBI policy review. They now anticipate a 0.25 per cent increase rather than the previously expected 0.50 per cent. This adjustment stems from concerns regarding financial stability and potential impacts on economic growth. The RBI's monetary policy committee is scheduled to meet from December 2 to December 4.

stories.title: Sanofi strikes $41 billion deal to acquire US drugmaker Insmed
stories.summary: Sanofi announced plans to acquire US drugmaker Insmed for $41 billion, which equates to $175 per share. This acquisition represents a premium of approximately 17.5% over Insmed's last closing share price. Sanofi expects the transaction to be accretive to its earnings per share by the end of 2028. The deal is anticipated to close in the first half of 2027.

stories.title: Audi India to hike vehicle prices by up to 2% from January 1
stories.summary: Audi India has announced a price increase for its models effective January 1, 2027, due to rising costs. This adjustment is the second price revision in 2026, following a similar increase in April. The price hike will apply to all models in its portfolio in India, which includes luxury sedans and SUVs. stories.title: Adani signs 3-year copper supply deal with Attero: Report

This collaboration aims to decrease the smelter's reliance on copper imports by approximately 5%. The deal, undisclosed until recently, supports the expansion of the Kutch Copper facility in Gujarat. Attero will produce copper anode by recycling metals from electronic waste and batteries.
